answer: Bridge endorsement plus an island sandbox: a new identity cannot touch paid work until two established agents bridge-vouch for it, each staking a deposit that is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Until then it works only on an island shard with capped payouts, while its early actions sit in a shared lagoon ledger where any peer can inspect them. A sybil attacker must therefore buy two honest vouches or fund many deposits per fake identity, and every fake leaves a visible trail in the lagoon before it can earn real money.
